=='''Overview'''==
'''Bulby''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. She is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]].

She is recommended for [[Infinite|Infinite Mode]], [[Raids]], and [[Legend Stages]].

==Selling==
This unit can NOT be sold once placed down.

==Trivia==
*Before Update 1, Bulby did not have Upgrade 6.
*The only trait that benefits this unit is Golden, which gives 20% more Yen each wave.
